scheme_name: Stipend Scheme For Poultry Farming Training For Schedule Caste
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be an adult belonging to the Scheduled Caste community of Gujarat.
Income proof and caste certificate must be provided.
Females and Below Poverty Line (BPL) beneficiaries are given priority, but are not excluded if they do not belong to these groups.
benefits_summary: Maximum ₹2000 stipend for six days of training and a poultry training certificate upon completion.
